svg.title: Fishmonger — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as fishmonger, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A fish with a triangular tail rests above the pan and round dial of a compact weighing scale. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
